title: Intelligent GTM Automation Platform
summary: Developing an AI-driven outbound system that connects prospect research, lead enrichment, personalised outreach, and follow-up tracking into one coordinated sales workflow.
challenge: Prospect research, lead enrichment, outreach, and follow-up often run as separate tasks, so context gets lost between steps and sales teams repeat work.
solution: An intelligent sales automation system designed to carry each prospect from research to enrichment, into personalised outreach, and on to follow-up tracking as one coordinated workflow.
contribution: I am designing and building this system with AI-assisted development, using Python, FastAPI, and LangGraph to coordinate the workflow and connect AI models and APIs.

title: Enterprise Document Intelligence System
summary: An AI-powered document intelligence system designed to search large collections of technical PDFs, understand natural-language questions, and generate relevant answers grounded in source documents.
challenge: Finding a specific answer across large collections of technical PDFs is slow when people have to search and read them by hand.
solution: A system designed to extract and index PDF content, match natural-language questions to relevant passages, and generate answers that reference their source documents.
contribution: I am designing and building this system with AI-assisted development, covering document ingestion, indexing, retrieval, and answer generation.

title: Speed-to-Lead Automation for Contractors
summary: A lead response system designed to help service businesses capture enquiries, organise prospects, and automate follow-ups before opportunities go cold.
challenge: Service contractors can miss valuable enquiries while working on site, causing delayed responses and inconsistent follow-ups.
solution: An automated workflow that captures, qualifies, organises, and routes new enquiries without constant manual monitoring.
contribution: I designed and built this workflow end to end as a portfolio demonstration: the enquiry form in Typeform, the lead records in Airtable, the automation in Zapier, and the acknowledgements and alerts through Gmail and Slack.

title: Smart Booking & CRM System
summary: A connected booking and customer management solution that brings appointments, staff availability, payments, and customer records into one workflow.
challenge: When appointments, staff availability, payments, and customer records sit in separate places, someone ends up reconciling them by hand and customer details fall out of date.
solution: A connected workflow that brings appointments, staff availability, Paystack test payments, and customer records together.
contribution: I designed and built this workflow as a portfolio demonstration, connecting Airtable, Zapier, Google Calendar, and Paystack. Payments run in Paystack test mode.

title: Nara: Business Management SaaS
summary: Building a business management platform for beauty and wellness providers, bringing bookings, payments, customer relationships, inventory, and financial visibility into one system.
challenge: Beauty and wellness providers often run bookings, payments, customer relationships, inventory, and finances across separate tools, which makes the business harder to see and manage.
solution: One platform that brings bookings, payments, customer relationships, inventory, and financial visibility together.
contribution: I am building Nara with AI-assisted development, turning business requirements into a working product on Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Paystack.
